metadata.title: How to Find Old Probate Leads
metadata.author: probatedata
metadata.shortDescription:
𝗢𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 kept following up with an older probate lead that never responded. Five years later, she called—and the opportunity involved two houses.

That individual case is an unusually patient example, but it demonstrates an important lesson: 𝗮𝗻 𝗼𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗳𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗮 𝗱𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱.

In this walkthrough, Jonathan explains 𝗵𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 and shows how to:

• 𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗱 older probate cases that have not been listed or sold
• 𝗦𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵 within a manageable historical filing window
• 𝗙𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗿 for available properties and usable contact information
• 𝗥𝗲𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 property, petitioner, and attorney details
• 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 a larger historical-prospecting pipeline
• 𝗜𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗳𝘆 out-of-state petitioners inside exported data

ProbateData helps real estate professionals 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗱, 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵, 𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘇𝗲, and 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸 probate opportunities more efficiently.

𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲: probatedata.com

Results vary, and the member story in this video should not be interpreted as a typical or guaranteed outcome. Platform screens and available features may change over time. Always verify court, title, property, contact, and market-status information before acting. This video is educational and is not legal advice. Follow all applicable federal, state, and local calling, texting, email, direct-mail, privacy, and Do Not Call requirements.
